headline: Crizac Limited releases investor presentation to the exchange
summary: Crizac Limited has submitted an investor presentation to the stock exchange. The filing provides an overview of the company's business and operational updates. Retail investors can review the presentation for detailed insights into company performance. Such routine filings offer transparency but generally have limited immediate impact on stock movement.
why_it_matters: Routine updates provide baseline data for existing company shareholders.

headline: Crizac declares interim dividend of Rs 4 per share
summary: Crizac Limited's board of directors met on October 30, 2026, and declared an interim dividend of Rs 4 per equity share. This corporate action provides direct cash returns to eligible equity shareholders of the company. Indian retail investors holding the stock as of the record date will receive this payout. Such dividend distributions impact the total return profile for retail portfolios holding the scrip.
whats_next: Record date and payment date announcements to follow
why_it_matters: Cash payout credited to eligible shareholders soon.
winners_losers: Crizac shareholders gain / company cash reserves reduced
